description: Generate token strings or UUIDs. Use for test identifiers; use generate-password for password fixtures. Seeded output is predictable and unsuitable for authentication credentials.

length.description: Output length parameter, 1–256, where applicable to the selected token type.

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed, intended for reproducible test output only.

type.description: Token format: uuid, hex, base64 or numeric.

name: generate-token
title: Generate random tokens or UUIDs
